item.title: Hardening Docker Containers Workshop
item.description: The reference handout for our Docker hardening workshop. It explains what a container actually is—ordinary processes on the host’s kernel, limited by namespaces, cgroups, and capabilities—and then works through safe base images, builds that don’t leak secrets, least-privilege runtime flags, and cutting an image down to what it uses.

item.title: DIY Mobile Verification Toolkit (MVT) Workshop
item.description: A self-paced, hands-on workshop on using the Mobile Verification Toolkit (MVT) for ethical mobile forensics. Complete it anytime. Occasional in-person sessions may be offered separately.
